issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies messageOnFeed() as a public abstract method (indicated by '+'), but the reference solution declares it as protected abstract in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java. This visibility mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about the intended accessibility of the abstract method and about how to implement/override it in subclasses.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the visibility between specification and implementation. Either change the solution declaration to 'public abstract String messageOnFeed();' in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java to match the UML, or update the problem statement/UML to indicate the method is protected. Preferably make the method public in the solution to match the UML's '+' visibility and reduce student confusion.
